what_happened: Mechanically reproduced the cited BimodalLogic:#833 incident by running the CURRENT plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, with PLAN_FILE_SCOPE_HARVEST_ROOT pointed at the real (read-only) BimodalLogic checkout, against the actual archived plan file for task 833. The harvester correctly appended both typst/generated/status.typ and the repository-root README.md to the harvested set -- exactly the two surfaces the incident reports as missed. Cross-checked against BimodalLogic's own specs/archive/state.json file_scope for task 833, which already lists both surfaces. This falsifies both of part (1)'s offered hypotheses (no .lean path harvested; ancestor-chain walk missing the root) and localizes the real gap to a pipeline-visibility issue outside the two files this task's file_scope declares.

The dispatch's own premise (determine why generated-surface appending did not cover the cited case) is refuted for the appending mechanism itself: plan-file-scope-harvest.sh already computes and persists the correct file_scope (verified by reproduction). The actual gap: the appended surfaces land only in state.json file_scope -- never written back into the plan document's own per-phase Files-to-modify prose (the harvester only reads the plan, never writes it), and never read by orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh when building an implement dispatch (file_scope appears there only in a sibling-batch-overlap comment). The implementing agent has zero visibility into the correctly-computed surfaces at the point it matters. A fix belongs in the dispatch-construction/plan-postflight pipeline, not in the two files this task declares.
